title: Reading Pace and Time-to-Finish
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:progress
| stats max(pct_complete) as progress, avg(pages_per_day) as pace, latest(pages_left) as left by book
| eval days_to_finish=round(left/pace,1)
| where progress<100
| sort days_to_finish
description: Estimates how long you will take to finish each book you are reading, based on your recent pace.
value: A finish forecast helps you decide whether to push on, and gently exposes the books you have quietly abandoned.
implementation: Ingest reading progress into `index=personal`; estimate days to finish per book.
visualization: Table of in-progress books by estimated days to finish.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how long you will take to finish each book you are reading, at your current pace.
